reference_total_definition: 2 x league-average points per team per game, games strictly before the reference week (no look-ahead); constant within a week by construction (F44 resolved by documentation 2026-11-14)
origination_order_note: The moneyline is derived only from the originated side and total through the empirical residual scale; no market price enters (F07)
results_feed_verification: Every row reconciles to the official standings (V01 / RF07); checks in data/results_feed_checks.csv
price_snapshot_store_note: fair_line is OUR origin snapshot for each originated market (walk-forward pre-game values for weeks 4-10, origination-run values for Week 11); the fair close is not yet recorded separately and the market open/close cells stay blank (F07/F51)
correlation_owner_rule: Register publishes input_A, input_B and qualifies_under_owner_rule per row; model-input correlations are labelled model diagnostics (DEC-09); C09 interval/p corrected to the slope's own SE (F48, REQ-8a-1)
